title:	Document-link picker should offer only the member's own documents, not every document in the tree
state:	OPEN
author:	maxi-smidt (Maximilian Smidt)
labels:	bug
comments:	0
assignees:

number:	770
--
## Bug Description

When linking documents (e.g. from the Story dialog), the "Linked documents" multi-select lists **every** document in the whole tree. It should be scoped to the relevant member's own documents (the members being edited/seeded), so you pick from your own selection rather than the entire tree.

## Likely cause

`DocumentLinkField` maps over all documents in the store with no filtering:

```tsx
// frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/DocumentLinkField.tsx
const { documents } = useDocumentStore();
const options = documents.map((d) => ({ label: d.title, value: d.id }));
```

The component already receives `seedMemberIds`, which could be used to filter.

## Expected Behavior

The options are limited to documents linked to the seeded member(s) — e.g. via `useDocumentStore.getDocumentsForMember(...)` — while still allowing inline creation of a new document (which is already wired up). Consider whether already-linked documents on the parent record should always remain visible even if they belong to another member.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The multi-select only lists documents belonging to the seeded member(s)
- [ ] Inline "Create document" still works and the new doc is immediately selectable
- [ ] Currently-linked ids are not dropped if they fall outside the filtered set (no silent unlink on save)

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/DocumentLinkField.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/StoryDialog.tsx`
- `frontend/src/hooks/useDocumentStore.ts`

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format is based on
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project
adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

Releases are cut from `vX.Y.Z` Git tags; pushing a tag publishes the matching
Docker images to GHCR (see [docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md)).

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Data-quality report now flags a child born after a parent's death year. A
  posthumous-birth grace window (~1 year) is allowed for fathers and
  parents of unknown gender, but not for mothers (#768).
- Research tasks: open questions and to-dos with open/done state, linked to
  any number of members (or none, for general tree-wide tasks), managed from
  the member sheet or created directly from the quality report. Tree nodes can
  show a toggleable indicator for members with open tasks, the quality report
  lists all open research items, and task changes appear in the activity log.
  Gated behind the new `research_tasks` feature flag (#725).
- Gallery face tags can now be marked as an "unknown person" (no member),
  which creates exactly one open, tree-level research task to identify them
  later. Resolving the tag to a member closes its task and turns the tag into
  a normal member link; deleting the tag removes its still-open task, while a
  completed task is kept as history. Gated behind the `research_tasks`
  feature flag (#736).

### Fixed

### Fixed

- Long, space-less document and attachment file names in the member sheet now
  truncate with an ellipsis (full name still available on hover) instead of
  pushing the sheet into horizontal scrolling. The member sheet was also
  widened to give the Records tab more room. Document file sizes in the
  Records tab are now end-aligned under the edit/delete icons, and
  double-clicking a document title no longer opens its file (the title's
  tooltip shows the full name instead; opening/downloading still works via
  the file row itself) (#772).
- Switching to the Life tab (or any tab) while creating a new member now works;
  the sheet previously stayed stuck on Identity until the member was saved
  (#771).
- The member sheet's Records tab now shows its content immediately when the
  sheet is restored directly onto it (e.g. after a page refresh) in edit mode,
  instead of appearing blank until you switch tabs and back (#767).
- Research-task chips in the quality report now open the linked person's
  record, instead of only switching to the tree canvas (#725).
- Upgrading from the early research-task development build now creates the
  missing task-link table and preserves every existing person association

## Code Review — PR #787

**What it does**: Scopes `DocumentLinkField`'s multi-select to the seeded member(s)' own documents (via the existing `getDocumentsForMember` store selector) instead of listing every document in the tree, while keeping already-linked documents visible even if they fall outside that scope — satisfying all three acceptance criteria from #770.

**Correctness**
- Filter logic (`scopedIds.has(d.id) || documentIds.includes(d.id)`) correctly unions per-seed-member documents with currently-linked ids, so saving can't silently drop an existing link — verified this against `MultiSelect`'s actual behavior (an unmapped `defaultValue` id renders no chip at all), confirming the "keep it in options" approach was necessary, not just defensive.
- Empty `seedMemberIds` (before any member is picked in Story/Event dialogs) yields an empty option list — correct, since both dialogs already require ≥1 linked member before submit.
- Inline "Create document" still works unchanged: the new doc is linked to `seedMemberIds`, so it lands in `scopedIds` on the next render via `refreshDocuments`, and is also covered directly since `onChange` immediately appends its id to `documentIds`.

**Style/conventions**: Matches surrounding code — no memoization was used before and none was added (consistent, not a regression); comment explains the non-obvious "why" (avoid silent unlink) rather than restating the code.

**Tests**: New `DocumentLinkField.test.tsx` covers both the positive scoping case and the "already-linked stays visible" case, following the existing `multi-select.test.tsx` polyfill/interaction pattern. Full suite (638 tests), `tsc`+`vite build`, and `check-i18n` all pass; no new user-facing strings needed since this is pure filtering logic.

**Risks**: None significant — small, self-contained change, no backend/API/schema touch, no i18n impact.
